decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked issue [ev-b290a36cb0c4] gives what the one-line note [ev-37215a11e33d] leaves out. Addresses assigned by the new IP auto-assign controller were treated as if a user had assigned them, so proxies used them even when the proxy did not use DNS capture. The fix makes these addresses follow the same per-proxy DNS-capture distinction as ephemeral auto-allocated IPs. That means the exposed environments are those using the new auto-assign controller that have proxies without DNS capture, and the consequence is that those proxies no longer use the controller-assigned addresses. The evidence does not name the exact configuration keys, which is why confidence is low.
